exercises.question: Which sentence describes a present/future hypothetical? [¿Cuál describe una situación hipotética presente/futura?]
options: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría. [If I had more time, I would travel.]
Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had had more time, I would have travelled.]
Tengo más tiempo. [I have more time.]

exercises.sentence: Si ___ más información, habría decidido de otra manera. (tener) [If I had had more information, I would have decided differently.]

exercises.english: If things had been different, I would have accepted.

sentences: Hubiera elegido otra opción. [I would have chosen another option.]
Si hubiera tenido la oportunidad. [If I had had the opportunity.]
Si hubiera tenido la oportunidad, habría elegido otra opción. [If I had had the opportunity, I would have chosen another option.]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly describes a hypothetical consequence? [¿Cuál describe correctamente una consecuencia hipotética?]
options: Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If the plan changed, something different would happen.]
Si cambiaría el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If I would change the plan, something different would happen.]
Si cambié el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If I changed the plan, something different would happen.]

exercises.sentence: Si fuera posible, ___ otra alternativa. (elegir) [If it were possible, I would choose another alternative.]

exercises.english: If I had taken another path, it would have been different.

exercises.question: Which sentence best integrates hypothetical language? [¿Cuál integra mejor el lenguaje hipotético?]
options: Si tuviera otra oportunidad, cambiaría mi decisión, pero si hubiera tenido más información, quizá habría elegido otra opción. [If I had another opportunity, I would change my decision, but if I had had more information, I might have chosen another option.]
Tengo una decisión. [I have a decision.]
Elegí una opción. [I chose an option.]
If I had more time, I would travel.
If I had had more time, I would have travelled.
I have more time and travel.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría viajado.
options: If I had had more time, I would have travelled.
If I had more time, I would travel.
I travelled because I had more time.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tomado otro camino, habría sido diferente.

options: Elegiría otra. [I would choose another one.]
Elegí otra ayer. [I chose another one yesterday.]
Elegiré otra ayer. [I will choose another one yesterday.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué habría pasado si hubieras tenido más tiempo?

options: Habría elegido otra opción. [I would have chosen another option.]
Elegiría otra opción mañana. [I would choose another option tomorrow.]
Elegí otra opción ayer. [I chose another option yesterday.]
Elegiría otra alternativa. [I would choose another alternative.]
Elegí otra alternativa mañana. [I chose another alternative tomorrow.]
Elijo otra alternativa ayer. [I choose another alternative yesterday.]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly contrasts the two hypothetical patterns? [¿Cuál contrasta correctamente los dos tipos de hipótesis?]
options: Si tuviera tiempo, viajaría; si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had time, I would travel; if I had had time, I would have travelled.]
Si tuviera tiempo, habría viajado; si hubiera tenido tiempo, viajaría. [If I had time, I would have travelled; if I had had time, I would travel.]
Si tendría tiempo, viajaría; si habría tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I would have time, I would travel; if I would have had time, I would have travelled.]

template.prompt: Give a past hypothetical and its consequence.
template.answer: Si hubiera tenido más información, habría tomado otra decisión.
